{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''bacta storage facility''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was the target of a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] strike by the [[Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] learned of it, they sent a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] force to [[Mission above Imperial City|infiltrate]] the facility while [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] flew cover. During the confusion, former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] brought the hidden [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' out from beneath Coruscant's [[City/Legends|cityscape]] and escaped from the planet.
